text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team selects tasks from a backlog, which is a prioritized list of work. These tasks are often written as user stories, describing what a user needs. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to adapt quickly to changes and deliver useful results regularly.
